atoms.statement: Learner-facing IA uses TRACE/LINK/PIECE/CATCH; Runtime V2 internal stages are not mandatory child-facing screens.
First TRACE pool contains NEW items only.
TRACE review mode may mix prior and re-hidden items with current items.
TRACE is rapid, think-first, low-input; tap/voice/small blanks are optional lightweight confirmations.
Exploration Crew uses character_id; walkie-talkie may deliver voice input and one short learning-safe hint.
atoms.owner: Hide consumes / Snap owns crew grammar

atoms.statement: LINK contains principle/verified relation, related-choice discrimination, and mixed connection test.
Etymology/root/Hanja/sound/decomposition claims require verified evidence; otherwise fail closed.
PIECE is final spelling/form/critical-structure completion and generalizes beyond English.
CATCH is the child-facing record/treasure space for found, missed, re-hidden, weakness and review entry.
Primary bottom-nav candidate is HOME/홈, EXPLORE/탐험, CATCH/보물함; Korean primary with small English above.
Memory Ladder is not a required bottom tab; access from Home/CATCH/completion.
Ready owns goals, planner/dates and family completion sharing; Hide owns specialist activity, pre-start sharing and completion report.
Hide emits evidence events to shared badge system; global badge policy/catalog stays shared/Snap-family-owned.
Badge system may include playful mistake/persistence badges but no shaming or ability labeling.
UI avoids emoji, uses ultra-high-density illustration, character placeholders instantiated by character_id, and preserves calm one-action hierarchy.
Old FIRST FIND→...→SEEK AGAIN sequence is internal/runtime lineage, not mandatory learner-facing navigation.
